title: Evaluation of the affine inverse polynomial
statement: Let $K$ be a field, let $\omega \in K$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $i \in \{0,\dots,n-1\}$ index one of the $n$ coordinates. Then for every point $x = (x_0,\dots,x_{n-1}) \in K^n$, evaluating the affine inverse coordinate polynomial $1 + \omega^{-1} - \omega^{-1} X_i$ at $x$ yields \[ 1 + \omega^{-1} - \omega^{-1} x_i. \]
hypotheses_covered: $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to K$ is an evaluation point in $K^n$
replaced:
For any $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to K$, the polynomial $\mathrm{affineInvPoly}\,\omega\,i$
evaluates to $1 + \omega^{-1} - \omega^{-1} x_i$.
